title: Tech Note: Creating and Administering 4D Portal

historical_commentary.text: 4D Portal as a distinct product is long discontinued, making the specific administration workflow described here obsolete; modern portal/dashboard applications would be built using current web frameworks or 4D's own modern web/REST capabilities rather than this legacy platform.
related_updates: 4D Portal has been discontinued; modern portal-style applications would be built with current web frameworks or 4D's own modern web/REST capabilities
